# loader

`component_interface`, `component_loader`, `installer<T>`, and `REGISTER_COMPONENT(name)` define the asset-component lifecycle, registration, lookup, import dispatch, filtering, and shutdown boundary.

## Contents

- [component_interface.hpp](./component_interface.hpp) — Defines `component_interface` with virtual lifecycle hooks, import handling, support filtering, and `game::XAssetType` identification.
- [component_loader.hpp](./component_loader.hpp) — Declares `component_loader`, `premature_shutdown_trigger`, `installer<T>`, `get<T>()`, and `REGISTER_COMPONENT(name)`.
- [component_loader.cpp](./component_loader.cpp) — Implements component registry ownership, lifecycle dispatch, cleanup, import resolution, exception handling, and shutdown signaling.

## API Surface

`component_interface` exposes `~component_interface()`, `post_start()`, `post_load()`, `pre_destroy()`, `load_import(const std::string&, const std::string&) -> void*`, `is_supported() -> bool`, and `get_type() -> game::XAssetType`.

`component_loader` exposes `register_component(std::unique_ptr<component_interface>&&)`, `post_start() -> bool`, `post_load() -> bool`, `pre_destroy() -> void`, `clean() -> void`, `load_import(const std::string&, const std::string&) -> void*`, `trigger_premature_shutdown() -> void`, and `get_components() -> std::vector<std::unique_ptr<component_interface>>&`.

`get<T>()` compares exact `typeid` values and returns `nullptr` when no matching component exists; `installer<T>` enforces `T : component_interface` and registers `std::make_unique<T>()`.

## File Relationships

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(name)` creates an anonymous-namespace static `component_loader::installer<name>`, which transfers each `name` instance into the registry returned by `get_components()`.

`post_start()` invokes `component_interface::post_start()` once, while `post_load()` invokes `clean()` before dispatching `component_interface::post_load()` once.

`clean()` calls `component_interface::pre_destroy()` before removing unsupported components, and `pre_destroy()` calls `component_interface::pre_destroy()` for every retained component.

`load_import()` queries every `component_interface` and returns the last non-null import pointer.

## Behavioral Contracts

`component_interface::load_import()` returns `nullptr`, `component_interface::is_supported()` returns `true`, and `component_interface::get_type()` returns `game::ASSET_TYPE_INVALID` by default.

`post_start()` and `post_load()` use static `handled` sentinels, return immediately on repetition, return `false` for `premature_shutdown_trigger`, and otherwise return `true`.

`premature_shutdown_trigger::what()` returns `"Premature shutdown requested"`; `trigger_premature_shutdown()` throws `premature_shutdown_trigger`.

`post_start()` and `post_load()` wrap `std::exception`, `const char*`, and unknown exceptions as `std::runtime_error` using `post_start failed in {}: {}` and `post_load failed in {}: {}`.

`log_component_event()` emits `[component_loader] {} {}\n` through `OutputDebugStringA`, `std::printf`, and `std::fflush(stdout)`.

`get_components()` owns a process-wide registry through a function-local static `std::unique_ptr` with a `std::function` deleter; registry destruction calls `pre_destroy()` before deleting the vector.

`typeid(*component_).name()` identifies runtime component types, and registry iteration follows Registry plus Chain-of-Responsibility dispatch patterns.
